design_philosophy: Objective, rigid, and functional. Designed as a developer control room. Features heavy use of monospace typography for data and stark contrasts for interactive elements.

layout.spacing: Dense internal padding (p-6) with crisp grid borders
layout.surface_strategy: Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton. Use border-r and border-b on grid items instead of shadow cards. The entire layout should feel like a single cohesive dashboard pane.
layout.container: w-full max-w-[1600px] mx-auto min-h-screen border-l border-r border-border bg-white

components.cards: Cardless style. Flat background (bg-white), 1px solid border-border, 0 shadow. Sharp corners (rounded-none).
components.buttons: Flat, stark contrast. Primary uses bg-black text-white hover:bg-black/90. Secondary uses transparent bg, 1px border hover:bg-gray-100. Sharp corners (rounded-none).
components.inputs: Flat, 1px border border-border bg-gray-50/50. Focus: ring-1 ring-black border-black. No shadow. Rounded-none.
components.tabs: Minimalist. Underline style with sharp borders. Active state: border-b-2 border-black text-black.
components.header: Solid White with hard bottom border-border. Height 64px. Flex container with health/readiness badges on the right. Pinned to top.
components.badges: Flat, text-xs uppercase tracking-wider. bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 border border-gray-200. Status badges use specific colors (e.g. bg-green-50 text-green-700 border-green-200).

interactions.hover: Subtle background shifts (bg-gray-50 to bg-gray-100). Links get underline.
interactions.motion: Minimal. Fast transitions (150ms ease). No bounce. Only opacity and simple background color changes.

icons: lucide-react (stark, clean linework, usually size 16 or 20)
specific_instructions_for_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the main grid layout to ensure the 'border-collapse' technical look. Avoid using pre-built Card components if they force rounded corners and shadows.

The layout should have a left sidebar/column (col-span-1 lg:col-span-4) for inputs (Upload, S3 URI, JWT, Sync/Async toggle) and a main area (col-span-1 lg:col-span-8) for Output (Markdown/JSON viewer).
Do not use generic shadows anywhere. The UI must feel flat and functional like a CLI or pro developer tool.
For the JSON viewer and Markdown preview, use the 'IBM Plex Mono' font and a light theme with specific syntax highlight colors (keys in blue, strings in green, numbers in orange).
Apply the background_texture to the body with extremely low opacity (opacity-5) and mix-blend-multiply to give a subtle paper/matte feel to the otherwise stark digital UI.
The Health/Ready badges in the header must be small uppercase labels with a status dot.
Implement a clear 'Correlation ID' display block that looks like a terminal output or copyable field in the results area.
Use standard HTML input type='file' disguised as a sharp-edged dropzone area.
Use data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='upload-dropzone', data-testid='sync-toggle', data-testid='jwt-input', data-testid='job-status-badge').
